clinical_indication: Active surveillance for prostate cancer, Gleason 3+4, with an increase in size of a left midgland lesion.

findings.finding_summary: Acinar adenocarcinoma in the right posterior site (site C), involving 1 of 3 cores, Gleason score 3 + 4 = 7, measuring 2mm within a 14mm core (apical third).
Acinar adenocarcinoma in the left midzone site (site E), involving 1 of 3 cores, Gleason score 4 + 3 = 7, measuring 5mm within a 16mm core (basal half).

report_summary: Template prostate needle biopsy (sites A-G, 22 cores total) shows acinar adenocarcinoma in 2 of 22 cores at 2 of 7 sites (right posterior and left midzone). Highest Gleason score 4 + 3 = 7. Maximum cancer length 5mm, at the left midzone site.
